content.short: Megapot is an onchain $1,000,000 lottery with daily draws, where liquidity providers act as the house.
content.description: Megapot runs an on-chain lottery with a $1,000,000 jackpot and a daily draw, built on Base. Instead of a company keeping the edge, liquidity providers fund the prize pool and earn yield as the house. It raised $5M in a round led by Dragonfly with Coinbase Ventures participating, and it is listed as a mini app in World's ecosystem directory, where it also partners with World mini-app builders to embed its jackpot.
content.meta: Megapot is an onchain $1M daily-draw lottery on Base where LPs are the house, also a World App mini app.
